description: The municipality lists historic courtyards and noble palaces included in the 2016 and 2017 Cortili Aperti events. The description identifies normally private historical residences opened to visitors on 22 May 2016 and 21 May 2017. This is an event-bounded list of built heritage venues, not an inventory of all historic buildings. Geometry, construction dates, structural condition and subsequent access are not established. Coverage is Lecce, Puglia, Italy. Native metadata declares CC-BY-4.0. The public catalogue provides descriptive metadata and the listed distribution links. Costs, access conditions for later file use and present completeness remain unknown. The supplied facts come from source descriptions and distribution labels; data values and file contents were not inspected. No specific simulation method is documented. Related models and platforms are not identified. The two annual venue lists are grouped as one municipal event series; overlapping buildings are not counted as independent assets. The 2016 secondary distribution is described as XLS but has an OP_DATPRO format label, an unresolved source-format discrepancy.
